metaDescription: Order custom 22 oz products in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events and giveaways with your logo.
introHtml: 22 oz products hit a sweet spot between capacity and portability, making them a favorite for corporate events, trade shows, and employee gifts. Whether you choose a double-wall insulated bottle for hot or cold drinks or a durable plastic cup for outdoor gatherings, this size offers versatility without being bulky. Decorate with your logo using screen printing, laser engraving, or full-color wrap to ensure your brand stands out at every sip.
